input_view.label_source: latest explicit disposition phrase in final 20 percent
input_view.masking: Starts after the SCR headnote (judgment body), stops at 70% of the document, masks gerund, 'we allow/dismiss', 'deserves to be', HELD and subject-verb disposition phrasings.

held_out_protocol.comparison: Freeze the trained candidate, then evaluate it once with the same input view and label schema.
